question: Which legend won the Laureus Lifetime Achievement Award 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kelly Slater**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kelly Slater**, an American professional surfer, is widely regarded as one of the greatest surfers of all time.
 
• He has won a record-breaking **11 World Surf League Championships**, showcasing his dominance in the sport over decades.
 
• Slater was honored with the prestigious **Laureus Lifetime Achievement Award in 2025** for his exceptional contribution to surfing and his unparalleled achievements in the sport.
 
• Beyond his sporting accomplishments, Slater is also known for his work in **environmental conservation** and advocacy for ocean health, further solidifying his legacy.
 
• His influence on surfing extends beyond competition, as he has also contributed to the development of surfing equipment and wave pool technology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kelly Slater's Career Highlights:**

 
 
• He started surfing at a very young age and turned professional in the **1990s**.
 
• He won his first World Championship title in **1992** and continued his dominance across multiple decades.
 
• Slater holds the record for being both the **youngest (20 years old)** and the **oldest (39 years old)** world champion in the history of professional surfing.
 
 
 
• **Laureus Awards:**
 
 
• The Laureus World Sports Awards were established in **2000** to honor the best sports achievements across the globe.
 
• The **Lifetime Achievement Award** is one of the highest honors, given to individuals who have made an extraordinary impact on their respective sports.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Advocacy:**
 
 
• Kelly Slater is a prominent advocate for ocean health and environmental sustainability.
 
• He co-founded the clothing brand **Outerknown**, which focuses on sustainable and ethical production practices.
 
• Slater has partnered with organizations like **Surfrider Foundation** and **Sea Shepherd** to promote marine conservation.
 
 
 
• **Innovations in Surfing:**
 
 
• Slater has contributed to the advancement of surfboard design and technology.
 
• He developed the **Kelly Slater Wave Company**, which created an artificial wave pool that offers perfect surfing conditions year-round.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Serena Williams:**

 
 
• An iconic tennis player with **23 Grand Slam singles titles**, Williams is considered one of the greatest athletes of all time.
 
• However, she did not win the Laureus Lifetime Achievement Award in **2025**.
 
 
 
• **Rafael Nadal:**
 
 
• A legendary tennis player with **22 Grand Slam titles**, Nadal has made significant contributions to the sport.
 
• He has been honored with several accolades but not the Laureus Lifetime Achievement Award in **2025**.
 
 
 
• **Usain Bolt:**
 
 
• The fastest man in history, Bolt holds the **world records** in the 100m and 200m sprints.
 
• While Bolt has won multiple Laureus Awards, he did not receive the Lifetime Achievement Award in **2025**.
